Presentation.Title: Family office advisory rooted in Swiss governance
Presentation.Subtitle: Multi-family office partner for wealth structuring, succession and cross-border coordination.
Intro: Ark Fiduciaire supports entrepreneurs, family shareholders and single-family offices who need a Swiss desk to orchestrate wealth, governance and reporting. We consolidate banking, legal and tax stakeholders to deliver a unified view and actionable roadmap.

From Geneva and Lausanne we pilot trusted local providers, digital reporting and bespoke governance frameworks so that family charters, holdings and philanthropic projects remain aligned with Swiss regulation.
